battle.name: 中原大戰
battle.theater: 中原地区（中國華北、華中）
battle.brief: 1930年5月，蔣介石領導的國民革命軍與閻錫山、馮玉祥等軍閥在中原地區爆發大規模內戰，雙方動員數十萬兵力，激烈的炮兵與步兵戰鬥導致大量傷亡。期間，法國製造的雷諾FT輕坦克（1917年服役）被閻部用於突破防線，展示出新式裝甲兵器的戰術價值。

kit.name: 雷諾FT輕坦克
kit.history: 雷諾FT輕坦克是第一款採用旋轉炮塔與履帶底盤的輕型坦克，1917年法國研製後廣泛用於一戰，並在1930年代被中國軍閥引進，成為當時重要的機械化裝備。

countries: 中原大戰不是兩個國家之間的戰爭，而是1930年5月至11月發生在黃河流域與河南省內、屬於同一國家內部的戰爭。蔣介石率領的南京國民政府與中央軍，對手是以劉鎮華所部河南軍為先頭，並獲馮玉祥西北軍、閻錫山晉軍支援的反蔣聯軍。5月初，戰端起於開封至鄭州間的隴海鐵路；南京軍沿平漢鐵路自湖北與豫南北上，封鎖車站、橋樑和黃河渡口；馮軍由西北方向向豫中增援，晉軍則由晉南與太行山東側方向越河南下。交戰重心先在鄭州及平漢鐵路兩側，之後延至開封、洛陽和豫東、豫西。10月晉軍先北撤，馮軍隨後退回西北，失去外援的劉軍接受改編，至11月初大規模戰鬥收束。
countriesEn: The Central Plains Campaign was not a war between two states. It was an internal conflict fought within China along the Yellow River and across Henan from May to November 1930. Chiang Kai-shek commanded the Nanjing Nationalist Government and its Central Army. Their opponents were an anti-Chiang coalition led initially by Liu Zhenhua's Henan forces and supported by Feng Yuxiang's Northwestern Army and Yan Xishan's forces from Shanxi. Fighting began in early May along the Longhai Railway between Kaifeng and Zhengzhou. Nationalist troops advanced north from Hubei and southern Henan along the Beijing-Hankou Railway, seizing stations, bridges, and Yellow River crossings. Feng's troops approached central Henan from the northwest, while Yan's forces crossed southward from southern Shanxi and the eastern approaches to the Taihang Mountains. The principal fighting first centered on Zhengzhou and both sides of the Beijing-Hankou line, before extending to Kaifeng, Luoyang, eastern Henan, and western Henan. Yan's forces began withdrawing north in October, Feng's main body then returned toward the northwest, and Liu's isolated army accepted reorganization. Large-scale organized fighting ended in early November.
people: 劉鎮華是開戰的先行者；他以河南綏靖公署主任身分掌握省內軍隊，5月初發出反蔣通電，並把開封、鄭州間的交通線推到戰爭前緣。蔣介石擔任最高統帥，能由南京調動不同戰區的師旅，並讓劉文輝、楊森、劉峙等所部在平漢鐵路一線協同作戰。馮玉祥把張自忠、韓復榘等所屬師旅投入豫中戰線，試圖與劉軍形成東西向策應；閻錫山則以徐永昌、楊愛源等指揮的晉軍兵團由北面加入。南京軍有較完整的鐵路調度與統一砲兵運用，聯軍三方卻沒有共同指揮機關，命令與兵力常不能同時到達。10月閻軍先行北返後，馮軍失去北方配合，劉鎮華也失去可依賴的外援，成為中央軍逐站壓進時的主要交戰統帥。
peopleEn: Liu Zhenhua was the initiator of the fighting. As director of the Henan Pacification Office, he controlled the provincial forces, issued an anti-Chiang telegram in early May, and made the transport line between Kaifeng and Zhengzhou the opening front. Chiang Kai-shek served as supreme commander, drawing divisions from separate operational areas through Nanjing and coordinating the troops of Liu Wenhui, Yang Sen, Liu Zhi, and others along the Beijing-Hankou Railway. Feng Yuxiang committed formations led by commanders including Zhang Zizhong and Han Fuju to the central Henan front in an effort to support Liu's forces from the west and east. Yan Xishan entered from the north through Shanxi formations commanded by figures including Hsu Yung-chang and Yang Aiyuan. The Nationalist forces possessed more integrated railway dispatch and centralized artillery employment, while the three allied armies had no common headquarters and could not always deliver orders or move troops simultaneously. After Yan's forces returned north in October, Feng lost his northern support, and Liu Zhenhua, deprived of outside assistance, became the principal opponent confronting the Nationalist advance from one railway station to the next.
kits: 五月初的接觸主要發生在鐵路沿線。中央軍若干德械師的步兵使用漢陽八八式七點九二公厘步槍，河南軍及西北軍中受日系裝備補充的部隊則常見日本三八式六點五公厘步槍；各師並不是整套配備完全相同。機槍火力包括中央軍序列中的中國二四式七點九二公厘輕機槍，以及部分日系部隊使用的日本二六式六點五公厘輕機槍。砲兵方面可見中國八八式七五公厘野戰砲，受日系武器補充的連排也有日本二四式七十公厘迫擊砲。三八式在一八九七年已經定型，漢陽八八式步槍、中國二四式輕機槍及日本二四式迫擊砲均在1924年前後列裝，二六式輕機槍於1925年列裝，八八式野戰砲在1920年代後期亦已進入軍隊。這些型號在1930年均已存在。實際火力差距不只取決於武器數量，還取決於七點九二與六點五公厘彈藥能否沿鐵路送到前線、七五公厘砲彈及迫擊砲彈何時抵達射手陣位。中央軍有限的飛機主要執行偵察與標定任務，野戰電話則協助砲兵和步兵維持協同。
kitsEn: The first contact in May occurred mainly along the railways. Infantry in several German-trained Nationalist divisions used the Hanyuan Type 88 rifle in 7.92 mm, while Henan and Northwestern formations supplied with Japanese equipment commonly used the Japanese Type 38 rifle in 6.5 mm. The divisions did not all possess identical complete sets of weapons. Their machine-gun fire included the Chinese Type 24 light machine gun in 7.92 mm, used in Nationalist formations, and the Japanese Type 26 light machine gun in 6.5 mm, found in some Japanese-equipped units. Artillery included the Chinese Type 88 field gun in 75 mm, while some Japanese-supplied company-grade units had the Japanese Type 24 infantry mortar in 70 mm. The Type 38 rifle had been standardized in 1897; the Hanyuan Type 88 rifle, Chinese Type 24 light machine gun, and Japanese Type 24 mortar were all fielded around 1924; the Type 26 light machine gun entered service in 1925; and the Type 88 field gun was already in military service by the late 1920s. Every model mentioned had been listed by 1930. The actual difference in firepower depended not only on the number of weapons but also on whether 7.92 mm and 6.5 mm ammunition could be carried forward by rail, when 75 mm shells and mortar bombs reached their firing positions, the limited use of Nationalist aircraft for reconnaissance and observation, and field telephones linking infantry with the artillery.
tactics: 第一輪競爭集中於車站、道岔、機車庫、鐵路橋和黃河渡口，而不是立即決定一座城池的歸屬。河南軍沿隴海線向鄭州方向施壓，晉軍由北面逼近平漢線，馮軍則從西側調動兵團；南京軍依托平漢鐵路與南北補給線，以縱隊和師旅逐段封鎖，使聯軍無法同時會合。6月至7月的攻防沿平漢線北段及隴海線東西兩端延伸，聯軍每次向北或向西壓進，都必須擔心另一支部隊不能掩護側翼。步兵進攻通常沿鐵路路基和兩側道路分段展開，攻擊分隊在機槍掩護下接近據點，七五公厘野戰砲先射擊車站、渡口與集結位置，迫擊砲則從彎曲道路或土堤後方射擊。守軍利用河岸、車站和連續陣地逐層抵抗，先以機槍封住道路，再由迫擊砲攻擊接近縱隊。航空偵察與騎兵巡邏被用來發現縱隊移動和鐵路破壞處，中央軍同時保護軌道、車輛和砲兵陣位。秋季戰局改變後，晉軍先撤回山西方向，馮軍失去北面配合，前線由攻勢轉為有次序的撤退與重新編組。
tacticsEn: The first contest centered on railway stations, switches, engine depots, railway bridges, and Yellow River crossings rather than immediately settling the possession of a single city. Liu's forces pressed toward Zhengzhou along the Longhai line, Yan's forces approached the Beijing-Hankou line from the north, and Feng moved formations in from the west. The Nationalist army relied on the Beijing-Hankou Railway and its north-south supply route, sealing the front in successive sections with columns and divisions so that the allied armies could not unite at the same time. From June through July, the fighting extended along the northern section of the Beijing-Hankou line and along both the eastern and western sections of the Longhai line. Every allied advance toward the north or west had to proceed without assurance that another formation would cover its flank. Infantry attacks generally advanced in sections along the railway embankment and the roads beside it. Assault groups approached strongpoints under machine-gun cover; 75 mm field guns fired at stations, crossings, and assembly areas; and mortars fired from behind bends in the road or earthen embankments. Defending troops used riverbanks, stations, and successive positions, first fixing roads with machine-gun fire and then directing mortars at approaching columns. Aerial reconnaissance and cavalry patrols were used to locate moving columns and damage to the railway, while the Nationalist army protected its tracks, rolling stock, and artillery positions. After the situation changed in autumn, Yan's forces withdrew toward Shanxi first. Feng then lost support on his northern flank, and the front changed from offensive operations to an ordered withdrawal and reorganization.
data: 可核對的時間線可分成數段：1930年5月上旬，劉鎮華發出反蔣通電，開封、鄭州兩端的鐵路開始戒備與調兵；5月中下旬，鄭州及平漢鐵路南北方向出現首批主要接觸；6月至7月，交戰沿隴海鐵路和平漢鐵路兩側擴大，開封、洛陽、豫東與豫西先後成為兵團調動和補給的軸線；8月至9月，雙方反覆爭奪車站、渡口及被破壞的鐵路路段；10月，晉軍首先北撤，馮軍隨之削弱正面兵力；11月初，劉軍接受改編，大規模有組織戰鬥停止。地理上，鄭州是平漢鐵路與隴海鐵路的交會點，開封控制向東的鐵路通道，洛陽則是通向豫西的樞紐，黃河渡口決定晉軍能否由北面進入河南。現存各方通令、戰報與後來整編名冊對部隊數量採用的口徑不同，同一支隊也可能因隸屬變更而被重複計算，因此不宜列出單一總兵力。傷亡紀錄同樣存在統計時點、俘獲名冊與戰後編入數字無法互相對照的問題，本文不提供未經確證的精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: The defensible chronology has several stages. In early May 1930, Liu Zhenhua issued his anti-Chiang telegram, and the railways at the Kaifeng and Zhengzhou ends of the line were placed on alert while troops moved. In the middle and latter part of May, the first major contacts developed around Zhengzhou and along the Beijing-Hankou Railway to its north and south. From June through July, the fighting spread along both sides of the Longhai and Beijing-Hankou railways, with Kaifeng, Luoyang, eastern Henan, and western Henan successively serving as axes for moving and supplying formations. From August through September, both sides repeatedly contested stations, river crossings, and damaged railway sections. In October, Yan's army withdrew north first, followed by a reduction in Feng's strength on the principal front. In early November, Liu's forces accepted reorganization and large-scale organized fighting ceased. Geographically, Zhengzhou was the junction of the Beijing-Hankou and Longhai railways; Kaifeng controlled the corridor eastward, Luoyang was the gateway to western Henan, and the Yellow River crossings determined whether Yan's forces could enter Henan from the north. Surviving orders, reports, and later unit rosters do not use consistent methods for counting troops, and the same formation may be counted more than once after changes of command. A single aggregate strength therefore cannot be stated responsibly. Casualty records likewise differ in their reporting dates, prisoner rosters, and later absorption figures. No unverified exact total of casualties is given here.
cause: 中原大戰的根源是1928年全國名義統一後，軍隊指揮、番號、番號歸屬與補給仍未真正集中。南京國民政府推行全國性的軍隊編遣方案，要求固定師級編制，並把支付、補充和指揮權收歸中央。對馮玉祥與閻錫山而言，縮編意味著各自經營的兵團可能被拆散，因此兩方面把蔣的軍事中央化視為直接威脅。河南位於平漢與隴海鐵路交會附近，又駐有受劉鎮華節制的軍隊，成為南京推行改編和統一指揮的首要突破口。1930年春季，南京開始調動湖北、豫南及其他地區的師旅向北集中，並要求河南方面接受新的軍事部署。劉鎮華擔憂所部被分割、指揮權被取代，遂在馮、閻支持之下於5月初通電反蔣。於是，中央整編政策與地方軍隊生存之間的矛盾，先在河南軍事部署上爆發，再把馮玉祥、閻錫山與蔣介石之間尚未解決的權力衝突帶入全面交戰。
causeEn: The underlying cause of the Central Plains Campaign was the incomplete centralization of command, unit designations, and supply after China achieved nominal unification in 1928. The Nanjing Nationalist Government promoted a nationwide army reorganization plan, fixing divisional establishments and bringing pay, supply, and command under central authority. To Feng Yuxiang and Yan Xishan, reduction and reorganization meant that the armies they had built might be broken apart, so both regarded Chiang's military centralization as an immediate threat. Henan's location near the junction of the Beijing-Hankou and Longhai railways, together with the troops stationed there under Liu Zhenhua, made the province the principal place where Nanjing attempted to implement a new command and deployment system. In the spring of 1930, the government began moving divisions from Hubei, southern Henan, and other areas northward and required the Henan command to accept a new arrangement. Liu Zhenhua feared that his forces would be divided and his authority replaced. With support from Feng and Yan, he issued an anti-Chiang telegram in early May. The clash between central reorganization and the preservation of independently controlled armies therefore first appeared as a deployment dispute in Henan, then expanded into open war among Chiang Kai-shek, Feng Yuxiang, and Yan Xishan.
impact: 南京方面的首要收穫不是全歼馮、閻兩部，而是取得河南並恢復對鐵路樞紐的直接控制。平漢與隴海鐵路重新連接華東、華中、鄂北和晉豫方向，使鄭州、開封與洛陽不再由地方聯軍控制，中央政府取得更大的戰略縱深與調兵空間。馮玉祥失去在河南的外部基地，主力退回西北，軍隊規模、活動區域與政治影響力均明顯受限；閻錫山仍保有山西根據地，卻在未取得全勝的情況下先撤出河南，晉軍的攻勢與政治聲望受到損失。劉鎮華的獨立軍隊則失去原有的軍事身分，其部隊被陸續納入南京序列。這場戰役使蔣的中央地位上升，也加深了中央軍與馮、閻方面之間的不信任；但它沒有消滅北方地方軍力，編遣、指揮和補給問題仍未解決。
impactEn: The principal gain for Nanjing was not the destruction of Feng's and Yan's entire armies, but the recovery of Henan and direct control over its railway junctions. The Beijing-Hankou and Longhai railways again connected the eastern, central, northern Hubei, and Shanxi-Henan approaches. Zhengzhou, Kaifeng, and Luoyang were no longer controlled by the allied regional armies, giving the central government greater strategic depth and more freedom to transfer troops. Feng Yuxiang lost his external base in Henan and returned his main body toward the northwest, sharply reducing his army's operating space and political influence. Yan Xishan retained his base in Shanxi, but withdrawing from Henan without a decisive victory reduced the offensive momentum and political prestige of his forces. Liu Zhenhua's independent army lost its former military status, and its units were gradually incorporated into the Nanjing command structure. The campaign strengthened Chiang's central position and deepened mistrust between the Nationalist army and Feng's and Yan's regional forces, but it did not eliminate the armies of the northern warlords. The questions of reorganization, command, and supply remained unresolved.
result: 10月的結束先由晉軍開始。閻錫山各部依序由北面渡口與山區道路撤回山西方向，使馮玉祥無法再從北面掩護平漢鐵路，也使河南聯軍的協同作戰失去主要支點。馮軍隨後收縮正面兵力並向西北轉進，劉鎮華所部則被南京軍從南面逐段隔離。蔣介石把平漢鐵路部隊重新集中於鄭州方向，先恢復隴海線重要車站，再向北推進；劉鎮華在失去兩位盟友後轉向接受南京的整編安排，所部陸續被拆分、併入或改隸其他序列。開封、鄭州、洛陽及黃河主要渡口回到國民政府控制，鐵路運輸與軍事調度重新運作。到11月初，交戰各方已停止大規模有組織攻勢，這場戰役在戰術結果上是南京軍保住並奪回河南，在政治結果上是劉鎮華失去獨立軍權；但馮、閻兩方面都保留了相當實力，並非遭到決定性的全滅。
resultEn: The collapse began with Yan's army in October. Yan's formations returned in stages toward Shanxi through the northern crossings and mountain roads. This prevented Feng Yuxiang from obtaining northern support for the Beijing-Hankou Railway and removed the principal support from the Henan coalition. Feng then contracted his strength on the main front and shifted toward the northwest, while Liu Zhenhua's troops were progressively isolated by the Nationalist army advancing from the south. Chiang Kai-shek reconcentrated troops along the Beijing-Hankou Railway around Zhengzhou, restored the important stations on the Longhai line, and then resumed the advance northward. After losing the support of both allies, Liu turned toward acceptance of the Nanjing reorganization program. His units were successively divided, absorbed, or transferred to other formations. Kaifeng, Zhengzhou, Luoyang, and the principal Yellow River crossings returned to Nationalist Government control, restoring railway movement and military deployment. By early November, the belligerents had ended their large-scale organized offensives. The tactical result was that the Nationalist army preserved and recovered Henan. The political result was the removal of Liu Zhenhua's independent military authority. Feng's and Yan's forces nevertheless retained substantial strength and were not decisively annihilated.
